Economy-designer: tools/sim.py still reads balance 'saturation' (removed) and models two-way pair routes; it needs a rewrite. Also storage_capacity/storage_refill/storage_start still not in balance.json.

handoff: REMOVED: saturation key from data/balance.json; saturation math in route_engine.gd; sat lines in the old route screen. Old route screen DELETED (game/route_screen.gd, its Routes button, route_clicked hookup and refresh in main.gd): it depended on the two-way model, so this was the minimum to keep the build loading; T57 only needs the planet-panel UI. Engine is one-way: record {id, src, dst keys, a, b planets, c, ships 1, state, reason}. Main API for T57: can_connect(src,dst,c), set_buy_order(planet,c,dest), set_sell_order(planet,c,source), remove_connection(id), connections_at(planet,c='') -> copies with status running|stalled|blocked, reason, net, role buy|sell; get_routes(). Ship auto-assigned from the free pool; none free -> reason 'No free ship. Buy a ship first.' (no auto-buy). Blocked (full destination or closed planet) emits main.route_blocked(id,text) and post_notice, red line on map; empty source or no cash stalls. Old saves lose their routes. No profitability check: negative-margin routes are allowed. Headless check passes; a standalone engine run settled cycles correctly.

details.per_cycle: units=floor(cargo/(2*travel)); buy fills source, ship moves, sell drains destination; costs trip+maintenance per running route
